_comment: Add a capability here and it appears in Jev's menu on the next run. No Python. arg types: span (a phrase selected out of what you said), app (any installed app), enum (one of the listed options; the value on the right is what gets substituted).

capabilities.description: Launch or switch to an application. Use when the speaker names an app to open, show, bring up, start or switch to.
Quit or close an application entirely. Use for quit, close, kill or shut down an app.
Create a new note in the Notes app with a title the speaker dictated.
run:
tell application "Notes" activate make new note with properties {body:"
{title}

"} end tell

capabilities.description: Add something to the Reminders app. Use for remind me to X, add X to my reminders, put X on my list.
Search the web for something the speaker asked to look up, google, or search for.
Open a new empty browser tab, without saying what to put in it.

browser.question: Which browser should the new tab open in? Pick the one the speaker named.

unspecified.desc: no browser named: this browser, the browser, just a tab

run:
tell application "{browser}"
activate
tell window 1 to make new tab at end of tabs
end tell

Safari:
tell application "Safari"
activate
tell window 1 to set current tab to (make new tab)
end tell
Arc:
tell application "Arc"
activate
tell front window to make new tab with properties {URL:"https://www.google.com"}
end tell

capabilities.description: Play, pause, skip or go back a track in whatever is playing music.
Change the Mac's speaker volume up, down, to a level, or to silent.

level.question: What volume level is the speaker asking for? Judge the level they name, not the direction of change.

quiet.desc: quiet or low, or turn it down without naming a level

loud.desc: loud, high, turn it up without naming a level

max.desc: maximum, full blast, all the way up

capabilities.description: Switch the Mac between dark mode and light mode.

dark.desc: dark mode, night mode, make it darker

light.desc: light mode, day mode, make it brighter

run: tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to {mode}

capabilities.description: Take a screenshot of the screen and save it to the Desktop.
Put a phrase the speaker dictated onto the clipboard, so it can be pasted.
Search the Mac's own files for something, rather than the web.

run:
tell application "Finder"
activate
make new Finder window
end tell

capabilities.description: Lock the screen or put the display to sleep.
The speaker clearly asked the Mac to do something, but it is not any of the capabilities above. Use this rather than forcing a bad fit.
Not an instruction to the computer at all. Small talk, a half-finished phrase, thinking out loud, or something addressed to a person.
